title: xo activity — live presence
description: Machine-local presence under ~/.quirq/watcher/activity/: which sessions are open right now and when they last did something. Heartbeat-style: refreshed on every meaningful action, stale entries pruned by the watcher.

opened_at.description: ISO-8601, or null when the runtime file carried no usable timestamp. T24 made this null rather than now(): stamping the current time for a missing value rewrote the document every tick and defeated write-on-change (syncplan §10 T24).

last_activity_at.description: ISO-8601, or null when the runtime file carried no usable timestamp. T24 made this null rather than now(): stamping the current time for a missing value rewrote the document every tick and defeated write-on-change (syncplan §10 T24).

host.description: Machine the session is running on.

project_id.description: Present only in the workspace aggregate.
